source.public_versification_note: Public 25:1–18, 26:2–65, 27–28 and 29:1–39 align directly. Public 26:1 combines Hebrew 25:19 and 26:1, each bound separately in source_segments. key_decisions.decision: Preserves the daughters’ distinction between their father and Korah’s revolt without identifying his unspecified sin.
Retains the daughters’ challenge, name continuity and concrete land claim; keeps brothers in the inheritance setting.
Makes the explicit affirmation of the women and emphatic grant audible; preserves inheritance transferred to them rather than to male guardians.
Keeps the stated priority and female heir in the new general rule without extending it beyond its terms.
Keeps this mountain within Abarim without inserting Nebo from another passage.
Preserves the gathered-to-people death idiom and connection with Aaron without narrating Moses’ death prematurely.
Makes plural responsibility refer to Moses and Aaron and retains the narrator’s identifying location after the speech.
Retains the divine title from 16:22 and male leader request without expanding it into a universal gender rule.
Leaves ruah unqualified as in the Hebrew; notes God’s spirit and leadership disposition as possible senses, retaining singular hand.
Renders hod contextually as authority while retaining some rather than total transfer; honor/splendor sense is noted.
Clarifies who seeks the decision while leaving his word’s ultimate referent open; retains the repeated going/coming and entire community.
Retains plural hands in the action despite singular hand in verse 18 and the final through-Moses agency expression.
